// diagnostic

E-ERR-PROPAGATE

Bare `?` propagation is retired.

What

Bare `?` propagation is retired.

Why

Fallible calls propagate automatically; `?(text)` is reserved for adding one failure-context frame.

Fix

remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-ERR-PROPAGATE: tests/ui/analytics_query_unknown_column.stderr.

Error [E-ERR-PROPAGATE]: bare `?` propagation is retired.

    |                                                                                        ^
 Why: fallible calls propagate automatically; `?(text)` is reserved for adding one failure-context frame.
 Fix: remove the trailing `?`, or write `?(text)` to add one context frame.
